none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: The objective is convex on the closed Euclidean ball of radius R and attains its minimum there. The class permits nonsmooth objectives.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: At a feasible query x, call k returns only the vector g(x,Zₖ). For each fixed x, its mean under the stationary marginal π satisfies the subgradient inequality against every feasible y. This marginal condition allows the conditional mean at an adaptive query to differ from a subgradient. Each call consumes the next path coordinate, including calls whose replies are discarded.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/PolynomialMixingSubgradient.lean, spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible and SubgradientOracle.support. LongTails/Template.lean, executeWithTrace and _run

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: For each feasible x, Eπ[‖g(x,Z)‖ᵖ] ≤ Gᵖ with G>0 and 1<p≤2. The bound controls the full reply under the stationary marginal. For p<2 it permits infinite variance.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Queries and outputs lie in the origin-centered closed ball of radius R>0 in Euclidean d-space, with d a positive integer. All parameters (d,R,G,p,β,τ,ε,δ) are public. The objective, reply map g and path law are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/PolynomialMixingSubgradient.lean, Params, Space, Domain, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.Instance, spec.Output and spec.admissible

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The real-valued seed path is stationary and absolutely regular. For every n and lag t, the total variation distance between the joint law of (Z₀,…,Zₙ) and the entire tail starting at Zₙ₊ₜ, taken together, and the product of their marginal laws is at most (1+t/τ)^(−β), with β>0 and τ≥1. This condition applies to general stationary processes and permits non-Markov dependence.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/PolynomialMixingSubgradient.lean, past, future, AbsolutelyRegular, spec.valid and spec.admissible

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The algorithm returns a measurable feasible point x̂ satisfying f(x̂)−minₓ∈Domain f(x) ≤ ε on the success event, with 0<ε≤GR/8. Any measurable output computed from the final state is eligible.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/PolynomialMixingSubgradient.lean, spec.Output, spec.valid and spec.successful. LongTails/Template.lean, Algorithm.output and execute

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: The success event has probability at least 1−δ for every admissible objective and oracle, with 0<δ≤1/32. Probability is over the oracle path and the independently drawn algorithm seed at a fixed call budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines a marginal p-moment subgradient oracle with a single polynomially absolutely regular sample path. Adaptive queries couple the chosen point to the next seed, and the fixed-budget guarantee must control the resulting objective gap at the requested confidence.
